text:
sam: Heads up - support reported a customer double-counted tokens after a streaming reconnect + preempt. Session 0x4f2a.

anya: Got the trace. Looks like runtime emitted truncated toolcall then fallback stitched a suffix. Billing shows two confirmed claims.

jordan: Did the toolcall id change on resume? If id stayed the same billing should dedupe.

anya: Same id (tc:314) in both events. But offsets differ because fallback rewrote them. Billing dedupe currently uses offsets+session which breaks here.

lee: Short term: add billing dedupe by toolcall id when present + provisional cache to avoid soft quota hits.

sam: Console ask: show route transitions and provisional vs confirmed per row so support can triage faster.

jordan: Also add router field handoff_reason (preempt/model_swap/net) and stitch_status (attempted/claimed/failed) to telemetry.

ops-bot: Ticket PLAT-1405 created: "streaming reconnect double-confirm investigation" - https://redwoodproj/PLAT-1405

lee: I'll open hotfix PR for billing dedupe (toolcall id) and provisional dedupe cache (10s).

anya: I'll add telemetry fields and a small trace flag to surface stitch events.

sam: I'll draft a support blurb and console mock for the timeline view.

jordan: Plan: canary hotfix -> 5% -> 25% -> full. Add alert if confirmed>provisional ratio spikes.

sam: Thanks team. Ping here with PRs/metrics and we'll coordinate refunds for impacted users. :thumbsup:
